answer: PoA binds every identity to a bonded escrow. If k identities under coordinated control equivocate at one consensus height, cryptographic evidence links their actions and imposes a correlated penalty of O(k²), not k separate linear fines. Once detected, a sybil swarm also triggers an exponential multiplier in capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation accelerating the ruin of reusable stake. Thus a nebula of aliases shares one inlet of risk, while each pearl of collateral remains slashable.
